A '''raid''' on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] took place prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Tiree/Legends|Tiree]] participated in the raid, saving some [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] who proved invaluable to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="JKTCG" />
